Three options worth shortlisting:

Saffron Dusk Clean Perfume — ₹2,849. “Clean” positioning and ingredient transparency make it worth checking first. Verify the full INCI/allergen list and whether fragrance ingredients are disclosed individually.

Madurai Jasmine Clean Perfume — ₹1,419. Lower-cost option with a clean-fragrance positioning. Verify essential-oil/fragrance allergens before use.

Naseem Asmira Aqua Parfum 100ml — ₹2,998. More conventional perfume option; check the complete ingredient list carefully if sensitivity is the priority.
